steps.text: I know what I said. No one could just watch from the sidelines. There could be no bystanders.
And yet, I still wanted to escape from the war. From Babel, from W, and from Her Majesty...
So I ran.
...What a hypocrite.
Do I regret it? Maybe.
But even if I stayed there, I wouldn't have been able to accomplish anything.
5:58 A.M. \ Light drizzle
Northernmost outskirts of Kazdel, mercenary camp at the edge of the warzone.
A few months after leaving Babel...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: This intel...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: C'mon, say something. You're normally pretty glib.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...What's there to talk about?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Why are you throwing a question back at me?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...This deadlock has been dragging on for ages. Do you think the scales will tip overnight?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What the hell happened these last six months? Aren't things moving way too quickly...?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We all know something went wrong.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But as to exactly where, nobody knows.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I guess I shouldn't say nobody.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Her Majesty... and the people around her. That never should've happened to them. That's what we all think.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But right now... what about us? Will the same thing happen to us?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Too soon. This war ended too quickly.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Up until last month, we were still working our contract with Babel. Then, they went quiet. We stopped getting any news...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Everyone knew which side we were on, and it's not like we were even ready to leave.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...If that's really the end of things, we have nowhere to run.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Tell the Messenger to start pulling contacts and see what intel we can dig up.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe we'll... have to return to the real battlefield.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I also figured that day was coming.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We all knew it deep down, didn't we?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If we really wanted to wash our hands of the whole thing, we wouldn't have agreed to work with them in the first place.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We could've left on our own, crossed Lake Valendan, and made a killing somewhere else—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ines, I...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: It'd be even harder for us to pull out of there. Too easy to get lost in that warmth. We'd get drunk on it.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe we should just abandon Babel and take our people away.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You still have that same old problem. You're getting sentimental again.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I can't tell you how long, but it feels like it's been ages since I've made a good decision that actually helped us.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe we really don't belong on the battlefield anymore...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Enough of that. Which one of us is the Sarkaz here?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Is there a single other place on Terra, like even a wooden shed over our heads, that can handle a bunch of bloodstained Sarkaz?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't always blame yourself. We all share the burden.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Also, looking back, I can say that you made the right decision to take in W.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She's made a lot of money for us. And offed a lot of people.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Hope so.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W... Is she still alive?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I don't think she'd die so easily.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She spent a decent amount of time with Her Majesty as well. Who knows, maybe she learned a thing or two.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We need to get a grasp quick of the situation in Kazdel right now. If we can find her again, things might get a little easier.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Do we really need her to back us up?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...What a damn shame.

steps.name: W
steps.text: —There you are. Ugh, you sure know how to run.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You look dead inside. I heard what you've been up to lately, W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Then, you should also know that you're the last one.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're right. As you can see, a lot of people died in this battle.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: All you're doing at this point is running up the score.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The way I see things, anyone who isn't dead yet has done a lot more than you ever have.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Do you need another reminder?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Theresa is dead. All of Kazdel, all of Terra will know that Kazdel has a new king.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But that was just a decapitation strike. A lot of your core operators are still alive.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Like that commander of yours who never showed up again. They made the right call.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: His Majesty didn't completely annihilate you because he wants to put a stop to the chaos. Kazdel needs him to pave a new path forward—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: —But what about you? Who are you to lecture anyone about right or wrong?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Of course you won't say it, but I know that's what you're thinking. And while you're thinking, you're trying to erase all those faces from your memory, one by one.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: After all, you're just here to vent. Just a petty little mercenary, drowning in her worthless revenge.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You can't beat anyone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I can definitely beat you, pretty easily too.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Killing me doesn't prove anything.

steps.name: W
steps.text: All you do is run your mouth. Are you trying to read my mind, or just getting some last words out before you die?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: A bit of both. I won't deny it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ever since that— since I almost choked on the blood of my friends, I haven't been able to hold a weapon.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We've all bled. Splattered it across Babel's palace. What you've seen, I've seen so much more.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But since you found me, I guess my fate is sealed. Hah.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Save your breath. To be honest... I just kinda wanna kill you. Call it a little relief from the stress of unemployment.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Bah... I really underestimated you, psycho.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Can you really pull that trigger without any anger behind it? Or, are you so far gone that you don't even feel anything?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're alone now... How many of our people do you plan to hunt down?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't you realize... you're not even thinking about Her Majesty Theresa? You're helping him silence us, and...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Will you shut it already? I thought you wanted to die?

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you ran back to your little Regent, do you really think I could butcher my way through Kazdel and drag all of you out one-by-one?

steps.name: W
steps.text: But you won't. None of you will. When you people killed her, you knew that you'd never be able to return to Kazdel again. You'll never go back to the way things were before.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nobody who actually saw what she looked like would've been able to keep cool. Except for those real monsters.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So you're all waiting for one special person: me, your executioner. I'm here to finally set you free.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And I'm doing it for free too! How great is that?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Tch... Self-righteous lunatic...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But, what you said is true...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We... We stained our hands with her blood... But even then...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You never should've call that man 'His Majesty.' Theresa is the only one who gets that title. You might've lived to speak a few more words.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I hope the usurper isn't rushing to get fitted for a crown. I mean, he'll be losing his head in a minute here. It'd be such a waste. Just wait 'til Theresa...

steps.name: W
steps.text: *sigh*.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Theresa...
If you don't surrender, you get other mercs on you. Next time, you'll be the prey.

steps.name: W
steps.text: —Well look who it is.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I thought you two left Kazdel ages ago... Long time no see.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Compared to how long this war has been going on, it was a weekend getaway. But I can't believe how you've grown.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I spooked you? Your hands are shaking.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Just a little rusty.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Our intel did say that you'd be alone here—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But we're almost 200 kilometers out from Taba. What do you plan to do with that rickety corpse of yours?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Or, have you been dragging yourself around like this for months, all alone...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: It wasn't that hard. But I guess there is a lot of stuff that's a pain in the ass to do by myself.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Like if you're rushing to patch yourself up, you could suddenly find your infection getting a lot worse?

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's whatever, as long as I don't die. And I don't die easy.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But that tower... looks familiar. Where are we?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Here? We're on the western battlezone. The coordinates are—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: —Oh, right. This is where 'W' died.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And where you joined us.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...This place has been blasted into ruins.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What, were you feeling nostalgic?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Do I look like the nostalgic type? My last target just happened to run over here.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know you two came for a reason. Just like last time, let's cut to the chase.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...The Regent has united all of Kazdel's armed forces.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The remaining mercenaries will also be united to form a real standing army, to be sent to all throughout Terra.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What a busybody.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's understandable.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Unless the big shots in Victoria and Laterano are useless pieces of shit with butter for brains, nobody is just going to sit back and let Kazdel rebuild after reunification.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Maybe we can borrow a few of the folks here and stir up some unrest again.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Bad idea, even if you're trying to get revenge.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't forget how many of our people with us now fought side-by-side with Theresa.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Sarkaz mercenaries like us never really had a dog in the fight. Most people don't like thinking. They just need someone to give them orders.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: So if all the Sarkaz will listen to the Regent, then he's won.

steps.name: W
steps.text: —Ines, did it hurt when you carved your horns to look all Sarkazy? Did they bleed?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Then your little disguise isn't even skin deep. Keep playing the Sarkaz and you're gonna get yourself killed.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Thanks for the concern. I can hardly contain my bile.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm just not in the mood to hear you calling yourself a 'Sarkaz' right now.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I decided to go down this path, and it's the only one I can follow at this point.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W, since Her Majesty Theresa disappeared, Kazdel has changed a lot, completely turned on its head.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Most Sarkaz don't have a choice. Not to mention, it's also a tempting proposition for many others.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...So let me guess, because you didn't have time to make it out, you accepted the murderer's proposal?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We'd be a bunch of icy stiffs if we didn't.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Looks like I'm not gonna be able to change your mind.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm not as cruel as you used to be. Why don't we let our swords do the talking... for old time's sake?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Slow up a minute... You might be interested in what I have to say next.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...We're not going back to Kazdel. We're headed to Ursus.

steps.name: W
steps.text: —Now that's a surprise. You should've said that earlier. I was this close to killing you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But you've got my attention. Let's talk, Captain Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Just outside Kazdel, there are some... Infected uprisings.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: They're paying top dollar for mercs, and the Regent is looking to manipulate some of the Infected for his own goals...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...the power of the Infected?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But most of their forces are still up in the frozen land of Ursus.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And the Regent's not interested in the dilapidated, vacant throne of Kazdel anymore. He's got his eye on someplace else.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The so-called 'Reunion Movement' is gathering the oppressed and downtrodden of all races. It's a fine piece to put in play for the next required step.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So nobody would get suspicious if we joined this Reunion Movement and left Kazdel far, far behind.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And then what?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...We'll take things one step at a time, W.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You already know what I want. And I also might know what you want.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're right. That does seem like a better move.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Mm. I am after a real monster here, after all.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And the old woman disappeared too... Maybe there really is no more reason to stay in Kazdel...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...But I'm not letting you two run the show this time. There's things I want to do, choices I want to make for myself. That cool with you?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The Regent will send someone to muster the mercenary army. If it's just between our little group here... that's fine.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We will help you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't worry. I've always been good at 'coping' with my boss.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...All right then.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Welcome back, 'W.'
...Getting away from Kazdel, huh.
W has changed a lot. She should have her own ideas now.
I pushed Ines down this path too, but she's stronger than I expected.
...As for me?
Occasionally, if you climb up somewhere high and look down, you can see the plumes of smoke rising from Kazdel.
Kazdel.
Maybe I'm the one who wants to escape from this place the most.
